author: Ingigo
body:
Hello there Avicus, if you don't remember me, I am Ingigo. I would like to ask you if I could be appealed and unbanned off the server Avicus. Firstly, I would like to apologize for all the wrong I have done on the server, such as lying and using autoclicker before I was moderator. I understand now that it was a very immature thing to do and that the server was only for fun and using that program was basically getting rid of that fun I should have had with all of you and the players of Avicus. Also, I only used autoclicker before being a junior moderator as I understood that using autoclicker then would be a stupid thing to do, hell it was a stupid thing to do at the first place. Secondly, I believe that I have served enough time being banned off Avicus as I believe that it was over an year if I calculated the time period correctly. I want to also thank Andy who banned me off Avicus as if he didn't ban me, I wouldn't have revised for my exams which will finish for the next three weeks, so thanks for that. Thirdly, I want to say again, that I am deeply sorry for doing those things that will against the rules, it was completely wrong of me to do that. I don't why I did it but as people say, when you are young, you do stupid things, but you will have to learn from those mistakes. I believe that I have and because I am older and more mature, I think I can follow the rules and make brilliant and awesome friends with you lot. I mean, that was the first reason why I joined Avicus in the first place. I am so, so, sorry, I will never do anything like that ever again. Thanks for reading this email, and I hope I could meet you on the server Avicus.
Thanks, Ingigo
